column1: # Named RAM variables, I/O registers and flash data. kind: ram|io|flash.

column4: summary
Port A data: PA0 precharge, PA1 discharge contactor, PA2 DC-DC contactor, PA3 heater relay (written by relay_write_portA).
Port B data: bit5 set at the end of init_all; bit6 toggled by the 10 ms PIT interrupt. Purposes not established.
Port A direction: all outputs (0xFF), set by portA_init.
Port B direction: bits 5 and 6 are made outputs at boot.
COP watchdog restart register: writing 0x55 then 0xAA kicks the watchdog (every 10 ms from main, and in delay loops).
Interrupt vector base: set to 0x7F by clock_pll_init, so the CPU vectors sit at 0x7F10-0x7FFF.
Interrupt configuration address: selects the vector block whose routing and priority are written next (XGATE setup).
MSCAN0 register block. The firmware never initializes CAN0, so ISR_CAN0_rx never runs.
MSCAN1 register block: the RV-C / charge-controller bus, 250 kbit/s, open filters. Base pointer in g_can_x_regs_ptr.
Port T data: bits 0-2 are driven by the measurement routines. Purpose not established.
Port M data: bit6 high while a Modbus reply is sent (Likely RS-485 driver enable); bit7 used by the cell-monitor routines.
Port H data: bit3 toggled every 1 s by main (status LED); bits 1-2 driven by the measurement routines.
MSCAN4 register block: the BMS command and telemetry bus, 250 kbit/s, open filters. Base pointer in g_can4_regs_ptr.
PIT control register: pit_init writes 0xE0 (timer enabled, stopped in wait and freeze modes).
XGATE module control: written 0xFBC1 at boot (XGATE enabled, stops in freeze mode, interrupts enabled).
CAN4 ext 0x999 d0:d1 (word). Dead debug command in stock: nothing reads it. The patches make the command inert.
CAN4 ext 0x999 d2:d3 (word). Dead debug command in stock: nothing reads it. The patches make the command inert.
CAN4 ext 0x999 d6. Dead debug command in stock: nothing reads it. The patches make the command inert.
CAN4 ext 0x999 d7. Dead debug command in stock: nothing reads it. The patches make the command inert.
1 = heater output inhibited: heater-check temperature above 40.0 °C for 30 calls; 0 once below 39.1 °C.
PIT-derived task flags: bit0 10 ms (COP), bit1 50 ms, bit2 100 ms main task, bit3 1 s LED, bit7 500 ms.
Hottest of the four temperature probes, signed, 0.1 °C.
Coldest of the four temperature probes, signed, 0.1 °C. Drives the low-temperature alarms and the heater.
Heater-check temperature, 0.1 °C: mean of the 4 probes (spread < 10 °C), else (sum - 2 x max) / 2.
Probe number (1-4) of the hottest probe.
Probe number (1-4) of the coldest probe.
Relay object for PA1 (discharge / 48 V contactor): bit0 request, bit2 output, bit3 ready.
Relay object for PA2 (DC-DC / total-negative contactor): bit0 request, bit2 output, bit3 ready (gates PA1 and heater).
Precharge object used by the PA1 sequence: bit2 drives PA0; bit1 set after 7 failed precharge retries.
Precharge object used by the PA2 sequence: bit2 drives PA0; bit1 set after 7 failed precharge retries.
Relay object for PA3 heater: bit0 request (heater_control), bit2 output (request and no over-temp inhibit).
State of charge, % as a single-precision float.
Charge-overcurrent alarm object: bits 0-2 L1-L3, bit3 reset, bit4 open PA1, bit5 open PA2, bits 6-7 level.
Discharge-overcurrent alarm object (same bit layout as g_alarm_obj0).
Cell-voltage-difference alarm object (diff_vol1/2): L1/L2 and level bits; no contactor-cut bits.
Temperature-difference alarm object (diff_temp1/2): L1/L2 and level bits; no contactor-cut bits.
Cell overvoltage alarm object: bits 0-2 L1-L3, bit3 reset, bit4 open PA1, bits 6-7 level.
High-temperature alarm object: copy of the charge or discharge high-temp object for the current work mode.
Low-temp alarm object (charge or discharge copy); bits 4-5 also carry the heater's PA1/PA2 cut requests.
Cell undervoltage alarm object: bits 0-2 L1-L3, bit3 reset, bit4 open PA1, bit5 shed PA2, bits 6-7 level.
Pack overvoltage alarm object: bits 0-2 L1-L3, bit3 reset, bit4 open PA1, bits 6-7 level.
Pack undervoltage alarm object: bits 0-2 L1-L3, bit3 reset, bit4 open PA1, bit5 shed PA2, bits 6-7 level.
Low-SoC alarm object (SoC1/SoC2): L1/L2 and level bits; no contactor-cut bits.
OR of bits 4-5 over the 11 alarm objects: bit4 = open PA1 (discharge), bit5 = open PA2 (DC-DC).
Charge high-temperature alarm object (ch_temp_h1-h3): L1-L3, reset, PA1/PA2 cut and level bits.
Discharge high-temperature alarm object (dch_temp_h1-h3): L1-L3, reset, PA1/PA2 cut and level bits.
Charge low-temperature alarm object (ch_temp_l1-l3): L1-L3, reset and level bits.
Discharge low-temperature alarm object (dch_temp_l1-l3): L1-L3, reset, PA1/PA2 cut and level bits.
Table of 11 pointers to the alarm objects 0x2410-0x241A, filled by alarm_table_init.
Highest alarm level (0-3) over the 11 alarm objects; sent in CAN4 0x504 d4.
Number of alarm objects with a nonzero level; sent in CAN4 0x504 d5.
4-byte record kept in external memory: magic 0x55AA, g_heater_retry_cnt, then bit0 = UV DC-DC shed latch.
Heater attempts ended by UV L3 (saved in g_extmem_record); 3 or more locks the heater out until cleared.
1 while the coldest probe is below dch_temp_l3 (released 1 °C above); in charge mode the heater stays off.
Highest cell voltage, mV (word); the cell index follows at 0x25E6.
Lowest cell voltage, mV (word); the cell index follows at 0x25E9.
Pack voltage, 0.1 V.
Pack current as a float, A, from a second conversion; used by heater supervision. Sign convention not established.
Pointer to the CAN4 register block (0x0280), used by the command ISR and the telemetry scheduler.
Pointer to the CAN1 register block (0x0180), used by ISR_CAN1_rx and can_settings_multiframe_tx.
Settings frame 0x410 (8 bytes): capacity AH, cell count, temperature-probe count, module count.
Settings frame 0x411: charge overcurrent L1-L3 (ch_cur_h1-h3, A) and discharge overcurrent L1 (A).
Settings frame 0x412: discharge overcurrent L2-L3 (A), pack overvoltage L1-L2 (0.1 V).
Settings frame 0x413: pack overvoltage L3 and pack undervoltage L1-L3 (0.1 V).
Settings frame 0x414: cell overvoltage L1-L3 (mV), charge high-temp L1-L2 (°C).
Settings frame 0x415: charge high-temp L3, discharge high-temp L1-L3, charge low-temp L1-L3, discharge low-temp L1 (°C).
Settings frame 0x416: discharge low-temp L2-L3 (°C), cell undervoltage L1-L3 (mV).
Settings frame 0x417: cell-voltage difference L1-L3 (mV), temperature difference L1-L2 (°C).
Settings frame 0x418: temperature difference L3 (°C), feedback overcurrent L1-L3 (A), SoC low L1 (%).
Settings frame 0x419: SoC low L2-L3 (%), IR1-IR3 (stock never reads IR; the cvl recipe uses IR3).
Settings frame 0x41A (8 bytes); layout not decoded.
One bit per settings frame received (0x410-0x41A); all 11 (0xFF07) queues the save to external memory.
Last CAN4 0x300 payload (8 bytes): d0 bit2 + valid checksum resets all alarms; d0 bit0 enables the 0x311 SoC set.
Last CAN4 0x310 payload (8 bytes). Use not established.
Last CAN4 0x311 payload (8 bytes): d5 = SoC % applied when the last 0x300 had d0 bit0 set.
Last CAN4 0x312 payload (8 bytes). Use not established.
Last CAN4 0x313 payload (8 bytes). Use not established.
Settings-dump table header: bit0 = dump of 0x450-0x45A pending (CAN4 0x500 d2=02), bits 1-7 = 11 entries.
Telemetry table header: bit0 = enabled (set at boot and by CAN4 0x500 d2=01), bits 1-7 = entry count.
Payload of CAN4 frame 0x504 (8 bytes): alarm bits, d4 max alarm level, d5 alarm count, d6 relay byte.
0x504 d6: bit0 PA1 discharge, bit1 PA2 DC-DC, bit4 PA0 precharge, bit5 PA3 heater; other bits 0.
Work mode: 1 = charge, 3 = discharge, 0 = none (mode-dependent 100 ms tasks skipped). Also set by CAN4 0x100 d3.
System state: 1 in init_all, 2 until the power-on alarm pass, 3 running. Commands accept 3 or 4; no writer of 4 found.
1 when charge was detected with PA1 open (mode_detect_chg_dch); lets the heater start or retry.
1 when charge was detected with PA1 closed (mode_detect_chg_dch); lets the heater start or retry.
